items.summary: Recommendation: approve containment-only execution and authorize no new discretionary spend, monetization expansion, or budget commitment. AI spend was $963.569 for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-26 across 5,390 calls. Revenue evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. Site-attributed commission is $0 because the $4.92 is in an aggregate provider row that cannot be assigned without inventing attribution. Contribution margin, ROI, cost-to-learn, causal lift, and budget exposure are not calculable because infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, other operating costs, experiment-level costs, incremental outcomes, and owner-approved financial limits are absent. Minimum measurement: a period-aligned cost ledger matched to site-attributed commission, experiment-level cost and incremental outcomes, and approved monthly revenue, fixed-cost, marketing, and spend limits. Continue existing source-dated measurement and reconciliation only; reject unsupported forecasts or financial upside claims.
